question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class agent-scoped web/tool credential contract here, and should it live under agents.list[].tools.web or a generic per-agent plugin configuration surface?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but choosing the config location and precedence affects credential isolation, SecretRef resolution, plugin-owned config, docs, validation, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Design generic per-agent plugin/tool config
options.body: Define one precedence and SecretRef contract covering webSearch plugin configs and global tools.web before implementation.

options.title: Add only agents.list[].tools.web
options.body: This addresses the narrow issue fastest but risks a second credential source competing with plugin-owned webSearch config.

options.title: Defer to separate instances or env
options.body: This keeps the config surface lean but leaves shared credential, billing, and rate-limit isolation unsolved for multi-agent installs.

recommendation.title: Design generic per-agent plugin/tool config
recommendation.body: Define one precedence and SecretRef contract covering webSearch plugin configs and global tools.web before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about config/security boundary policy, and steipete is the strongest available routing signal from CODEOWNERS and recent config/SecretRef history.
